messages:
Erin (Sales): Heads-up — Northbridge wants to POC a drop-in replacement for CloudPrompt next Tues. Main asks: SLA parity, billing alignment for the first 90 days, and a compatibility shim so they don't rewrite frontend. Can we run through what we need? @Matt can you lead the tech checklist?
Matt (SE): Got it. I'll own the shim mapping + prompt parity tests. Quick list: tokenization deltas, streaming behavior, stop/timeout semantics, and default temperature differences.
Tess (Solutions): POC plan proposal: 1) Wire a proxy that maps CloudPrompt endpoints to Redwood, 2) Run 50 canonical prompts vs their production prompts, diff outputs, 3) Latency/SLA smoke, 4) Billing telemetry for identical traffic. Acceptance = <5% functional drift on critical prompts + avg p95 latency <= 300ms.
Jordan (Security): Security asks from Northbridge: SOC2 + SSO, KMS for keys, VPC peering for Private deployment option, and an encrypted audit trail. Also they sent a short security questionnaire — attached in the thread (I reviewed). We need to confirm data retention policy and whether we can sign a DPA.
Mike (Northbridge): Hi team — pricing is big for us. CloudPrompt gave a temporary price credit during migration. We need a clear migration rate/cardinality for tokens -> billing. Also, will there be any hidden per-request fees from the shim?
Erin (Sales): @Mike we can do a 3-month migration credit and set a committed usage floor. We should itemize per-token vs per-request differences in the POC report. No hidden per-request fees from our side — only normal API units.
Matt (SE): For the shim specifics, I'm thinking a lightweight proxy that rewrites paths and maps model names. Example mapping we're going to test (dev snippet):
```
# proxy-config snippet
match: POST /v1/predict
rewrite_to: /v1/chat/completions
headers_add:
  X-Redwood-Model: rdx-compat-large
  X-Forwarded-For: <client-ip>
```
We'll also normalize client token counting to match CloudPrompt's tokenizer by running a tokenization parity script.
Tess (Solutions): We'll create a small harness to do prompt-output diffs and include automated asserts (exact match on fields where they expect deterministic answers, fuzzy similarity for open generation). Also test streaming->nonstream fallbacks.
Jordan (Security): Quick notes: if they want Private (VPC) we can provision a customer VPC peering but lead time is ~2 weeks. KMS/HSM integration is supported — will need key provisioning from their side. I flagged a couple questionnaire items for legal (export controls + data residency).
Matt (SE): Edge cases to watch: 1) CloudPrompt accepts streaming tokens with partial JSON — our runtime may break some partial parses. We'll test partial-stream reconstructions. 2) Stop-sequence behavior: ensure we expose same stop tokens semantics or provide a shim that enforces it client-side.
Mike (Northbridge): Can you document any functional deltas we expect? We have 120 critical prompts used by search/rerank + 30 vendor templates. Need to see examples of where fallback behavior differs.
Erin (Sales): I'll assemble a short PS SOW for the 2-week POC: engineering hours, SE time for tests, and a 3-month credit note. Also adding a clause for a response-drift review at the end.
Tess (Solutions): Deliverables for POC: 1) Proxy config + deploy instructions, 2) Prompt diff report (CSV + examples), 3) Latency & billing telemetry, 4) Security checklist completion. I'll own the report.
deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded: shim-proxy-v0.1 -> staging (build 4521) :rocket:
Matt (SE): I'll push the tokenization parity tool and a sample corpus to the staging environment later today. Will run the 120 critical prompts overnight and post diffs.
Jordan (Security): Can we get a stubbed DPA to legal by EOD? I can attach a redline template. Northbridge expects DPA + standard security addendum.
Erin (Sales): Yes, I'll ping legal. Next steps summary: - Matt: proxy + token parity tests (by EOD) - Tess: POC harness + report template (by EOD) - Jordan: DPA redline + VPC lead times (tomorrow) - Me: finalize SOW and migration credit.
Mike (Northbridge): Thanks — that timeline works. Please include an explicit rollback plan in the SOW (we can't risk user-visible regressions).
Matt (SE): Rollback plan note: we can route 100% traffic back to CloudPrompt via DNS or LB weights within 15 minutes, and toggle model variant fallback to their original model mapping. I'll add the runbook steps to the report.
Erin (Sales): Great. I'll set a recurring check-in for the POC week daily standup in #sales at 09:30 PT. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
note: This thread is intended as a short, actionable presales coordination exchange for a customer POC migrating from a competitor API. Messages are terse and include technical snippets and next steps as typical on Slack.
